saveLinks.question: How do I save a link?
saveLinks.answer: Paste a URL into Juple, or share a link to Juple from another app such as a browser or social app. With Quick Save on, a shared link is saved right away; with it off, you choose Collections and add a memo before saving.

collections.question: How do I use Collections?
collections.answer: Collections let you organize links your own way. One link can belong to several Collections, and you can create a new Collection while you save.

archive.question: Where do I find saved links?
archive.answer: Home shows today's saved links, and Archive holds everything you've saved. Browse by date or all together, switch between List, Grid and Image views, and search.

sharedCollections.question: How do shared Collections work?
sharedCollections.answer: You can share a Collection with other people. What each participant can do depends on the permission you give, and some permissions may need approval before a link is added.

locks.question: How do locked Collections work?
locks.answer: The content of a locked Collection stays hidden until you unlock it. Its links appear redacted in Home and Archive, and the password is asked every time you open one while it is locked.

trash.question: What happens to deleted links?
trash.answer: Deleted links move to Recently Deleted in My Page. You can restore them there or delete them permanently; permanently deleted links cannot be brought back.

save.title: Save links with ease
save.description: Paste a URL, or share a link from your browser or social app. With Quick Save on, it's saved right away.

collections.title: Organize it your way
collections.description: Save a link to one or several Collections, and create a new Collection while you save.

find.title: Find saved links fast
find.description: Home shows today's links and Archive has them all. Browse by date or all together, in List, Grid or Image view, and search anytime.

share.title: Use Collections together
share.description: Share a Collection with others. Permissions decide what each person can do, and links may need approval.

lock.title: Lock sensitive Collections
lock.description: A locked Collection hides its links, and a password is needed to open them while it is locked.
